answer: Spawning fake identities costs real capital per node, and colluding rings must sustain gas across a grove of accounts, making farms economically unviable. Isolated sybils drift like seeds on a tundra, unable to reach attestation quorum, so honest participants earn reputation while attackers burn stake faster than they can mint credibility. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
